purpose: Public explanation contract for showing the evidence behind an important legal proposition.

example.what_we_say: For an applicable private residential tenancy, the general rent-review rule from 1 March 2026 is no more than 2% or CPI, whichever is lower, subject to applicable exceptions.
example.why_we_say_it: The proposition is linked to the 2026 residential-tenancy legislation, its commencement framework and current RTB guidance.
example.what_it_means: The rule is not applied until tenancy type, dates and applicable exceptions have been resolved.

publication_rule: The public component must distinguish legal text, official guidance and CICAN explanation rather than presenting them as the same authority.
